analysis.name: Kareem Usher
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 10 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: Kareem's lectures weren't great but he was generally too vague. He has very few assignments and the majority of it is group work but seems to take points off just because he feels he can't give out all A's. Don't buy the textbook even if he makes you think you need to and beware: he won't mention the strict attendance policy until the sem. is over.

Though the class was taught primarily by GTAs, whenever Dr. Usher would lead lecture it was uninspired and often embarrassing. He has a lot of experience in the field of planning but struggles to use that experience to create lectures which engage the class and teach the course material.

Dr. Usher is a very good professor, and his lectures were really informative. He always tries his best to engage the rest of the students in discussion during the lecture. He is very educated on his topic. Assignments aren't difficult, but attendance is weighted very heavily for this course.

he is so kind, the class itself feels unorganized because there is him and two phd students teaching as well. I feel he is clearer and more informative than them and if you go to him with a question he can definitely answer
Definitely recommend Dr Usher is great!

analysis.name: Zach Usmani
analysis.verdict: Well liked with reasonable difficulty, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 5 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Great guy who cares more about content of work rather than if it was submitted on time or met all the correct criteria. Super nice.
Just. Great. He may care your grade more than yourself. Extremely lively lectures.
Zach is extremely helpful with assignments and is very informed on policy and social work. I would highly recommend his classes to anyone who is interested in policy and macro practice.
Great professor and fast at grading!

Zach really knows his stuff when it comes to policy and social work practice. I learned way more than I was expecting to in seminar. He is also very lenient with due dates and when grading he cares more about content than format.

analysis.name: Ulises Juan Zevallos-Aguilar
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 12 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: He yaps A LOT. He once told us that Red Bull gives you stomach cancer, though there's no scientific evidence to back that up. There've been so many instances in which he's gone on a tangent and I'm just thinking to myself "How did I get here?" Why are we yapping about Star Wars and Lord of the Rings during a class discussion about neoliberalism?

He's a nice guy, but my entire grade for the semester was based off 100 points. This was very frustrating as having 4 points docked from a midterm or final (which made up near 50% of your grade) dropped your grade significantly. Attend class or you'll be screwed. He offers some extra credit, but not enough assignments with how little there are.

While the class ended up being easy to get a good grade, getting there was tough. He was not at all clear during lectures, and we never even talked about the actual poetry that the class was about, just beat around the bush. But that doesn't mean he didn't expect you to know it anyway. I'd say about 1/2 of each class was a total waste of time.

He was a pretty bad professor. He went on tangents in every class and wouldn't let anyone talk. He has a certain answer in mind when he asks a question and any other answer is just flat out wrong. Most of the class is pointless and you probably don't need to go but, he grades on participation and attendance, so that sucks. DON'T TAKE HIM.

He's a good guy, but I'm not sure what the point of the class was. We did e-journals for every class, a student presented on the reading, and then we had a class discussion. I'm not really sure what he did other than hand out a 93% to everyone. He's a nice guy and can be funny, but this class was a little frustrating.

analysis.name: Jim Talamo
analysis.verdict: Good teaching but expect to put in the work
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 54 reviews, fairly reliable

review_highlights.comment: Can be extremely biased and has favorites despite what all the other ratings say. Helpful to some but unhelpful to those who he doesn't look highly upon based on his own opinion. Exams are difficult and are usually harder than any practice exam. We had no test corrections but I heard the students now do so i'm not totally sure what that is like.

It is very easy to pass this class as long as you do something to stay up to date, either live lectures or the lecture preps are all super helpful. There is tedious homework assignments. Make sure to do the sample tests before each midterm/final because they are very similar to the real one. Also make sure you have a good group for team assignments

Literally the GOAT. He has in-person, online, and recorded lectures; the homework is relevant and important to your learning, and before all the midterms and finals he gave the last three semesters of those same tests. He wrote the program that the homework is done in, and has a built-in feature for just getting the answer and he is accessible too.

Jim posts lecture videos on canvas so I did not attend lecture, but the videos provided enough information to understand the material and get good grades on tests. Jim also allows test corrections to earn back half credit and practice exams that make getting a good grade in the class decently easy even though some of the material is difficult

Talamo makes the class extremely easy to follow along and understand. He also does a great job preparing students for midterms, giving plenty of resources and information well in advance. The only downside for 1172 is there is plenty of homework through Chimera. Still, 100/100 would recommend.

analysis.name: Jacob Urick
analysis.verdict: Below average reviews. Worth checking if this fits your learning style, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 9 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Guy dumped water all over my girlfriend right in front of me. Super weird.
TOP lad.... stood at the front of class with a super soaker and absolutely drenched people for getting questions wrong... righteous stuff

He once walked into office hours with a 5-gallon container of purified water slung over his shoulder, and proceeded to dump its contents onto a nearby female student. Thereafter Jacob immediately began to boisterously celebrate, punting the empty gallon at the ceiling and beckoning observers to chant as he completed a victory lap around the room.

Honestly just not a good guy. Demeaning with his vocabulary. Needed a bit of extra help and my questions were deflected and left unanswered. He is borderline unreachable and would cancel class at the last possible minute, rumored to be due to impromptu beach trips. Never felt so talked down to by an individual

This Guy went out of his way for kids to do bad in his class.  He would never answer any questions in class and was not a good guy overall.  Really wish I had the chance to leave the class when I did.

analysis.name: Upul Ranaweera
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 3 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Had him for Chem 1210. Everything was ok up until he served out the final exam that had 10 extra multiple choice questions and double the amount of short answer questions (when compared to the normal exams) and still gave us the same amount of time as if it were a normal exam.
an amazing professor just make sure to go to class

I took 1220 and 2540 with him. Chemistry is hard but he made it easier to understand. He has a good sense of humor and definitely really cares about his students. He might grade hard, but he will always explain why. His class is difficult, but he is always willing to answer questions during lab and explain things at office hours.

analysis.name: Ulrich Gerlach
analysis.verdict: Good teaching but expect to put in the work
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 12 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: I took a class in General Relativity from Professor Gerlach in 1973. He set me on a course of learning Physics, in which I previously had no interest. He was the biggest influence on my way of thinking ever.  I have spent 40 years pondering and reviewing the things he taught me. I am very grateful to Professor Gerlach.

Professor Gerlach is such a great lecturer and mentor to general relativity. He apperantly has vast knowldege on mathematics and physics. He is trying to help you build solid pictures on physics. You may think the course is lack of examples. But he is super available and willing to help everyone! Talk with him outside of the classroom. Respected!
Very good teacher.  I learned a lot from him. He makes sure you understand and if he sees the class does not understand a topic well he would revisit it.  His way of teaching is really good also.

He is a very nice and great professor, and he knows how to teach. He really wants to let you understand. He encourages you to ask questions in the class and he will even give you a penny for finding his mistake. 
Accessible outside the classroom, and very knowledgeable, will answer your questions in math, physics and engineering.
Outstanding professor, who used to give you a penny if you caught him making a typo/mistake on the whiteboard. Kept you alert!

analysis.name: Erin Upchurch
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 8 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Communication was horrible. I have an assignment from March 4th that hasn't been graded yet and it's almost May... The course has assignments that build on each other (parts 1-4) but you will absolutely not get any grade or feedback by the time the next part is due. When multiple students complained, we all got 20/20 with no feedback the next day..

Didn't learn anything from her. Online class, she was extremely late grading assignments, didn't respond to emails and would accept no late assignments, although she gave herself permission to be late and provided no feedback on assignments. Wasn't engaged in the course at all. Avoid taking courses from this instructor.

Erin is very transparent about her expectations and background as a social worker. The class emphasizes diversity and advocacy, and she really brought her experiences to the table. Participation was key. Erin really connected us to the material and the reality of the social work profession. Always respectful and honest.

My favorite professor at OSU! She has so much knowledge beyond what she's teaching. Class is easy, with lots of open conversations and guest speakers. She clearly cares about the mental health of her students. Was not a fast grader, but was an easy grader. I highly recommend taking a class with her!

Prof Upchurch is incredibly caring, knowledgeable, patient, uplifting, and wise. Class was over Zoom, lectures weren't very structured. Takes a while to grade papers but isn't a tough grader. Tip: do the study guide before taking quizzes, and skim readings prior to lectures

analysis.name: Hugh Urban
analysis.verdict: Highly rated with a manageable workload, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 49 reviews, fairly reliable

review_highlights.comment: Great professor! 4 papers (grades super easy), and one final group project (if you show up and present you get full credit). Mandatory attendance, but very light work class for a 4000 level course. Definitely take him.
Definitely one of the rock star professors at OSU. His class will be interesting and worthwhile.

The Hughru is a GREAT professor. He is very passionate about the subject matter and likes to have a good time while teaching. He uses a lot videos and class discussion to keep you interested. He is very skilled at rewording your answer to make you sound like a genius.
Showing up to class is automatically 30% of your grade. He is a great professor, his class is interesting and well taught, and the material is fairly easy.

Prof. Urban deals very well with the touchy subject of religion, and keeps his own opinions to himself pretty well. He really lets the students discuss the issues than touting his own opinion and he does very well at moderating the discussion, too. Attend lecture & recitation and take notes, and you shouldn't have problems with papers and tests.

analysis.name: Vincent Vu
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 9 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Homework was difficult, and the video lectures often didn't provide enough information to answer some of the questions. Takes off lots of points if formatting isn't perfect on homework documents.

Vu gives clear lectures and replies to emails quickly. He is sometimes a bit sassy/intimidating one-on-one, but it's coming from a good place. His exams are difficult but fair, and the HWs are reasonable. His occasionally super shiny head can be distracting during lectures - aside from that, he's much better than I expected.

Awesome professor who explains the concepts clearly. He runs the class in an efficient and high quality manner. However, he grades the exams very harshly and requires precise answers (but it is curved). Overall, a great professor who I would recommend!
Vince was a good lecturer, however, his tests were very difficult and he graded quite harshly. The midterm averages always hovered around 50% or 60%.

Vince is a organized teacher, but there were some problems. Firstly, whenever me or people ask for help in the discussion board, Vince would usually say "DId YoU nOT seE the LEcTure VideO?". I did see the lecture and readings and thats why I am asking for help in the first place. Secondly, the homework can be really challenging and really long...

analysis.name: Aimee Ulstad
analysis.verdict: Well liked with reasonable difficulty
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 43 reviews, fairly reliable

review_highlights.comment: The class is boring but fairly easy as long as you understand how to do the problems. Textbook is not necessary but you have to buy homework access. She is a decent professor and explains the material clearly. Exams are not very many questions so any question you miss will impact your grade significantly so be aware of that.

Aimee is an awesome professor. She does a great job of explaining the course material rather than just regurgitating it. She also gives you a chance to miss a few classes by putting her lectures online and dropping a fair amount of quizzes you take every day in class.
Very clear and always willing to help with the material. The 4 hour lectures can drag on and become very boring though as she goes through example problems at a slow pace.
Easy class, come to lectures, study example problems and it's an easy AB+. Lectures are long but I heard that's changing to hour lectures so it should be a good class

The course is short but the lectures can be boring. Purchasing homework access is forced but save yourself the money and don't bother with the textbook, it's not helpful in anyway. Forces you to do clicker questions from a phone app at random points during random lectures. The course isn't hard, just tedious.

analysis.name: KT Vandergriff
analysis.verdict: Below average reviews. Worth checking if this fits your learning style, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 57 reviews, fairly reliable

review_highlights.comment: i cannot emphasize how badly people need to avoid this prof. she can't explain any concept properly, will only do one example of a topic, and move on quickly. my notes don't even make sense when i write everything down. projects are very difficult. overall AWFUL!

Only 50% of students passed her class last semester.  Assumes every single student has an extensive background in coding. No chance to pass if you don't, and even if you do, like myself, you will struggle. Avoid at all costs.

Tests are way too hard and don't go over what you learn in the slides. She is a nice person, but an extremely difficult professor. Some of my friends in other classes got much easier and fairer tests, don't take her class. Probably half or more of my class failed.

The exams are very difficult and the midterm is only out of 50,  meaning that one wrong multiple choice question (out of 2) turns your midterm grade into a 96%, whereas the other professors' are much more fair and reasonable. Her classes do little to nothing, you need to study on your own. If you want to get a low grade, take her class

she's a nice person but i don't recommend her class. she expects you to have extensive prior knowledge (beyond what's taught in the prereqs) and the exams are harshly graded with questions that are purposefully tricky/confusing.

analysis.name: Vincent Sabino
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 4 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: The GOAT. Awesome professor who knows AND cares a lot about what he teaches. Class was both educational and fun. Take him if you can!

Sabina is an awesome professor. I learned so much from his class and he really cares about the subjects. As long as you follow directions and do the homework, he grades pretty easily. I am taking a second class with him and I would suggest him to anyone who really wants to learn something.
So finicky. Craft your every discussion post meticulously and make them half-page long or you will lose point! Vague directions and you have no idea why he is grading stuff that way. One word, picky.
Professor Sabino is an amazing instructor. If you show up to class and participate in his class you will be good. He is not a bad grader just put in the work and you will pass the class just fine.

analysis.name: Vladimir Kogan
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 62 reviews, fairly reliable

review_highlights.comment: This class is not THAT difficult if you put the time in. You have to go to every class, there are daily reading quizzes. The reading quizzes aren't that hard, they're just tedious. But 50% of your grade is condensed in the last two weeks: group debate, ten page legal brief, take home questions for the final, & the final. Overwhelming in the end.

Very organized, which can't be said of a lot of professors. Have to read because of daily quizzes and participation on Top Hat. Midterm and Final are take-home and not graded harshly. Debate and legal brief at the end are a bit overhwhelming. If you go to class and ready, you should do well with him. Good class for those thinking about law school.

Vlad is honestly a really good professor. One of the POLISCI profs that you can't tell off bat political standings (more right). Guest speakers were pretty ehn. Take home exams take up HOURSSSS. very time consuming and TAs grade them. pretty accessible. participation gives EC so either that or office hours will help buffer grade. MC exams cake.

This class is not hard, it's just time consuming. The only difficult part is the written midterm & final, which took me about a full 3 days to complete each. The grade criteria is very clear, it's just so many parts and a lot of combing thru long readings to complete. The MCQ is incredibly easy, the debate was brownie pts, and quizzes were simple.

If you want to talk about voting and gerrymandering for 16 weeks take this class Take home exams are incredibly time-consuming and difficult. Attendance is not mandatory but you lose so many participation points if you don't go, so you have too. He's a nice guy i guess but wouldn't take his classes again

analysis.name: Alana Vangundy
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 8 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Gives 3 assignments each week with readings. She makes you pay $80 for a textbook she wrote, embedded in a different program, not Carmen. Gives clear instructions but even if you follow she takes points off. One of the weekly assignments is consistently a 3-7 page paper. Only benefit is 100 free points in the class.

Dr. VanGundy was great! Be ready to think critically and apply many concepts to papers and exams. She lets you think for yourself and gives little to no instructions when writing papers. She grades easily, as long as you apply everything discussed in class. She is super inspiring and smart, and it is definitely reflected in the classroom.

Thoroughly enjoyed this class and the professor. She was very helpful and had great communication, and returned grades in about a week. Left wonderful and encouraging comments on all assignments, and provided an abundance of resources.

I would not recommend her. In lecture she often criticized our class stating we were one of her lowest grades and would make us feel like we were the problem. There were only five grades the entire semester which were two reflection papers, one legal analysis, a midterm, and a final. The exams were four questions, written, and worth 200 points.
A lot of writing but very rewarding! She clearly puts so much time into preparing lectures and grading papers. I got a lot out of this class

analysis.name: Vlad Kobzar
analysis.verdict: Most students had a tough time. Look into alternatives if you can
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 5 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Kobzar is a bad professor but he wants students to succeed. The class is not necessarily difficult, but it is boring and his lectures are a waste of time to attend as he writes notes directly from the book. He gives one homework assignment a week that is similar to what will be on the exams. You are allowed an 8x11 cheat sheet for exams as well.

FIND A DIFFERENT PROFESSOR IF YOU CAN. Lectures are mostly 1–2 rushed problems with little explanation and no reliable posted notes. He often appears unprepared and makes mistakes students must correct. Exams are excessive for the time (55 min, 11 pages); most couldn't finish half.

He is a nice guy, but not a good professor. His notes are not organized, and he can be all over the place during class. His midterms have fair material on them, but they are way too long for the 55 minute class period, and very hard to finish. For MT2 he gave us 32 questions, and the final was 12 written response. The DIffEq section is diffcult.

Though the professor was a decent guy, he often made mistakes and seemed unprepared. Exams were excessive (ex: 14 pages in 55 minutes), feedback was minimal, and limited office hours made getting help difficult. Quizzes served as the study guide and solutions were not posted until the day before the exam, which made it difficult to study.

TAKE A DIFFERENT PROF, others are much easier for midterms. He is ok at teaching lin alg but all over the place. For diff eq most of the class stopped going from how little sense he made. I consistently left the class more confused than I started with. Hw and quiz are easy but tests are unreasonably long.

analysis.name: Amit Vutha
analysis.verdict: Tough course, but students consistently rate the teaching highly, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 118 reviews, this is a reliable picture

review_highlights.comment: He is probably the most dedicated math prof at OSU. He is very easy to approach and made a hard class like Math 1172 doable. He is very knowledgeable and interested in what he does. Honestly he helped me change the way I look at math.

Amit is one of the best math professors I have ever had, always willing to help and arrange office hours to help you, it was 1172 so it is NOT an easy class by any means but his teaching is wonderful and he is a great guy.

Prof Vutha is the reason I did well in this class. He was always available to meet if you sent him an e-mail, even outside of his regular office hours. His exam reviews were thorough and clear, and he was genuinely interested in helping us understand the material. I remember before the final he held an open study session that went until 2am.

This guy is absolutely amazing. I wasn't even in his class, but Vutha subbed in once and I loved him so I attended his office hours. He treated me like a son. He spent hours upon hours tutoring me before every exam. One night, he opened up the math building and sat with us from 9PM-5AM to study for an exam.  Quality human being.

Amazingggg teacher, he is so understanding and wants everyone to succeed. I still reach out to him and go to his office hours even though I'm not in his class. He is always willing to sit down and help you no matter the math class you're taking. He has a diverse range of people he helps out, I meet someone new every time I go to his office hours.

analysis.name: Zhengrong Justin Wu
analysis.verdict: Good teaching but expect to put in the work, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 60 reviews, fairly reliable

review_highlights.comment: The course is actually pretty easy until the last 3/4 weeks. His final is NOT cumulative, which is a huge help. Go to his office hours, he hints at exam questions. You MUST go to lecture, and you MUST take good notes, he will test you on anything and everything on the slides + what he says. Weekly Quizzes + HW. Don't bother with the textbook

Hardest class I've ever taken in undergrad by a mile. Emphasizes understanding rather than memorization, but memorization is vital for the course. Office Hours are helpful. Exams are tough - no two ways. Have to know everything about the course material, and every little detail in between. If you aren't studying everyday, you won't do well.

Dr.Wu definitely wants you to succeed. His lectures are important as his exams are basically based on them. Not too bothered about the textbook although he does recommend practice problems that are just too enhance your understanding. Record his lectures and go thru his slides multiple times. He's also always ready to answer questions.

This class is very tough, almost as hard as organic chemistry. It sucks because most of your grade (like 75% of it) is based on the exams. Dr. Wu is funny, his lectures are engaging. Don't bother reading the textbook, but attend every lecture and record them on voice memos. He'll test on specific stuff he says that isn't in the book.

Hey, so, this professor is not good. "Why this is the case?" Because he asks if people have questions but genuinely hates answering them. His exams are tricky. His homework is brutal. The course content itself is challenging on its own - we don't need his quirks making it harder.

analysis.name: Yiying Wu
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 101 reviews, fairly reliable

review_highlights.comment: I really really love his teaching!!! Very good notes. It's better to attend every class because all those in class notes will help to get an A. Honestly, I do not read any chapter of book when I took his chem1210. Midterms are not tough but final is tricky. Be prepared of both lab and lecture notes when you take final.

Overall Dr. Wu was a good professor. His lectures were easy to understand, and while somewhat boring, he covered the material well. He also did demos occasionally to break up the lectures. He did a lot of practice questions during class and you submitted your answers. His practice tests were a good reflection of the exams. The textbook was helpful.

I had Dr.Wu last semester and thought he was ok. His lecture notes he provided were pretty helpful, however I felt like he gave little material outside of class unlike many other professors I have heard. Overall I would take him again, however it definitely was a bit of work outside of class to get a good grade.

Dr. Wu is a very caring guy and knows what he is talking about. I found the lectures helpful to get an overview of the topics, but I stuck with the textbook to fully understand it. He is a genuine guy and enjoys what he does, which has a positive effect on the students. While some concepts may be in the gray zone of teaching, he is still the goat.

I was intimidated at first because of his reviews, but he cares about his students, is very kind, he takes lecture slow, and sometimes he has to speed up because that's the class speed, but he always reviews with us, provides extra practice, homework is due at the last week of the semester, and he's always so sweet. I love Professor Wu!

analysis.name: Jae Westfall
analysis.verdict: Well liked with reasonable difficulty, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 17 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: Cares for students, meditation really helps relax, helps reduce stress and clears the mind. One problem is she is not really good at running her canvas but there isn't any assignments just have to do 2 meditations outside of class and type how it felt.

Ok, this wasn't the easiet 3 credit hour class but it was really interesting. The tests can be a little hard if you don't study. We had an open book midterm but there wasn't enough time to look through the book so study ahead of time.

Without a doubt the best professor I've EVER had. Such a loving professor, who has such a passion for her students and the material she's teaching. The assignments are a breeze, and are more focused on our personal growth rather than any strict material we'd need to memorize from a textbook. I would take this class a million times over if I could.

EDUPAES 250 - Avoiding Cancer. Interesting class with 5 assignments, 10 online quizzes, 1 project, and an online final exam. Seems like a lot of material, but they are all pretty easy to complete and do well in. Great professor who makes things interesting and worth going to class for! Easy A for anyone who needs a little GPA boost!

Easy A if u read...quizzes may be tricky but if u pay attention you should get an A with ease...and u learn a lot that u would have never thought about...great class, easy A, cant ask for much more...an its a 3 credit course that requires maybe a half hour of work a week if u pay attention..and final is all old quiz ?s

analysis.name: Dustin Williams
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 6 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment:
The class is extremely easy. The majority of the coursework is group projects that are very easy. The midterm and final were both online and open-note. Dustin's lectures are boring, but the material itself isn't too exciting either. 
Recommend if you want an easy A and need to learn how to use basic webdev technologies

Williams's lectures can be a bit dry, but then again, its web dev. The projects are graded pretty leniently and there were only 4 over the semester. He has a 'Tech Talk' in which teams just present on literally anything of their choosing for 10 minutes once in the class, again pretty easy grade. Midterms and final are also easy, remote & open note.

I would prefer to never take any of his online sections because they have awful timings and all he does in lectures is read out from the slides. This makes the class extremely boring. All these things add up to less than 10 students attending his class. He grades the projects pretty tough as well so I would strongly suggest on taking it in-person.

Pretty average lecturer (can be very boring and dry at some times). Where Dustin shines is his experience in the industry and the way he relates it to the class. He makes it very clear when something is relevant in today's careers and when something is obsolete. The class itself is pretty easy, you really have to mess up to fail. Would take again.

Great professor, kind and down to earth, always willing to explain. Class is all based on Group Projects. He's flexible and lenient on grading, made a pretty tough class into a pretty chill class. Only criticism is that his lectures can be a bit dull and its easy to doze off. He's always accessible outside of class tho. Would recommend.

analysis.name: Linan Wang
analysis.verdict: Most students had a tough time. Look into alternatives if you can, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 39 reviews, fairly reliable

review_highlights.comment: def knows his stuff but doesn't know how to teach intro bio students. will go through info so fast and you have to catch it to do well. doesn't explain lab procedures at all. most of the time we didn't know how to perform experiments. very true that he LOVES to ask questions like “ready for the next test” “ready for the next quiz?” was not fun :(

I had a terrible time in this class. Avoid this TA if possible. I asked him about my extended response answers on an exam and he read them in front of my group and proceeded to tell my why I was wrong and make fun of me. He also continued to make jokes about my responses in future labs. Also if you think it will be a quick lab you're wrong.

Recitation is a long game with convoluted question delivery. We get no review or deeper explanation out of the content, simply play the game for an hour then do lab. Procedural demonstration and explanation is minimal at best, many technique issues prolonged labs. He also demeans incorrect answers as a joke, discouraging figure engagement.

Explanations were very frequently unclear and unhelpful. Turned recitation into a pointless and confusing “zombie game” every week. Entire lab was often left unsure of how to proceed. If you see this name on your schedule, you may want to switch labs.

I've never made a review, but this TA needs to be warned about. You can tell he hates teaching, he always flies through lab with bare minimum instruction and at x15 speed. He seems to enjoy seeing you stressed by constantly saying how hard the exam is. I asked about the best study resources and he literally just shrugged. Avoid to save your grade!

analysis.name: Waleed Muhanna
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit, and ratings have been declining

Professor Abate is amazing, her class is set up very organized and deadlines are fair. The professor was very likeable, and the homework was not too hard. Lectures and readings were very easy to follow, and she doesn't bombard you with work like a lot of professors do.
Her online classical mythology was very well organized and she was great at teaching through her videos, exams where also easy.

analysis.name: Amy Sheneman
analysis.verdict: Below average reviews. Worth checking if this fits your learning style, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 13 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: I remember that a couple of years ago, I asked during office hours if I could get the study materials for the final exam early because I hadn't done very well on the previous exam. She did provide the materials as I requested, but later I heard that she complained to her earlier lecture about a certain “student” asking for them ahead of time.

I enjoyed Professor Sheneman's audit class for the most part. The exams were difficult, so you really need to understand the "why" behind the concepts or you will struggle. She does not lecture in the traditional sense, you must read the book to get a grasp of the material. There is opportunity for extra credit and she does curve.
She is of the opinion that there can only be a certain number of A's per semester. This means she will reduce your grade if she thinks enough people have gotten A grades already.

Love Sheneman. Definitely the most entertaining professor at Fisher. If you get a chance to choose her for Audit you should. Wish I could have taken more than just the one class with her. Audit is hard, but she makes it decent through lectures and helpful exam study guides.
She is not teaching the material, and the exam is extremely hard. No matter how much I study, everything I prepare for the exam feels pointless.

analysis.name: Amanda Hummon

Recitation attendance is mandatory and worth a decent chunk of the grade so don't skip recitation. The labs for this class weren't bad but make sure to take the math seriously because the post lab is very unforgiving.

lectures are kind of boring, mostly reading off the slides. prepare to spend a lot of time learning about muppets that you will promptly forget. she is quite nice though and tries to do her best at teaching. however, she is a researcher as well so she does skip a few days due to conventions/talks.

Her lectures were honestly amazing and informative. She not only delivered the material effectively, but went out of her way to connect with students in the lecture hall. She is passionate about chemistry and I enjoyed going to her lectures.

Dr Hummon is such an amazing professor. She made everything very fun, and was easy to learn from. Because 1610 is chem for majors, but uses 1210 exams, she teaches a bit more than what you need to know for exams. Please take her!!

analysis.name: Amie Hufton
analysis.verdict: Well liked with reasonable difficulty, and ratings have been declining

review_highlights.comment: Dr. Hufton is very caring of her students. If turned in late, specific assignments have a three-day grace period, and there are no exams. Assignments were graded fairly and easily if you followed all the directions. Some assignments required time to be set aside, but nothing was too hard. She would put out weekly announcements for the class!
Plenty of writing, but it's not going to destroy you, it's very doable and easy if you just read the passages properly. Just do the hard work well and on time, and you'll get an A.

Dr. Hufton was always excited to teach us, so that made me excited to learn from her! You'll usually work with classmates during lecture and the in-class assignments are designed to make one think in a way that they usually haven't before. My brain is bigger because of her class.

Dr. Hufton is the best professor I've had at OSU! The reflection essay assignments will seem intimidating at first, but you get used to writing them, they genuinely facilitate learning the material, and are not graded very tough. She really values student feedback and will dedicate time to what you really need and want to learn.

Dr. Hufton truly cares about her students and I really enjoyed the opportunity to meet with her for feedback during office hours. The class consisted of discussion posts and small projects throughout the semester. I would say expect spending 2.5 hours on the class per week. Highly recommend this professor!

analysis.name: Baha Amayreh

Prof. Baha was easily one of the worst professors I've had at OSU. His explanations were confusing, his questions vague, and his grasp of basic programming concepts shockingly weak. Lectures were frustrating, poorly communicated, and felt like a waste of time. Avoid if possible.

Baha's midterms and final exam are unfair and insulting to the student. During his lectures, he does not actually teach, and has the students teach the material amongst themselves. He will randomly email from his phone, asking you to resend a file that he misplaced. Please find another lecturer to take 3901 with as I believe it CAN be a good course

Very unorganized professor and the exams are very detailed, make sure you know all possible functions of Ruby, JS, and all possible stylistic elements of CSS and HTML. Idk why he has so many 1/5. he's one of those professors who makes you laugh in class. i never found myself staring at the clock wondering when class is over. i will say though, that he isn't the best at explaining things and sometimes is even wrong about content. but 3901 has really easy content to understand so chatgpt was able to explain better.

He mumbles and talks extremely fast so it's difficult to understand. He offers no help and expects an illogical amount of effort from the students. If you get this professor run away.

EEOB majors, this is an easy class,  common sense. But he can't make a rubric to save his life. Poor lecturer, talks too fast to understand, and will be condescending if questioned. I LOVE HER. She actually tries to make her class interesting and it is. I had her online, so I didn't get to speak to her, but the class was super easy! I would definitely recommend if you don't want a class that deals with too much work and easy grades!

Nice professor, but the lectures were very outdated, seemed like she's had them since the 90s-early 2000s. No exams, just a few reflection papers (all very short), quizzes, and discussion posts. The class is a pretty interesting topic and the professor is very cool. Very nice.

Does a really good job at breaking down material and making it easy to understand and interesting. Reasonable grader.

Good dude.

The course was fast-paced, therefore it was a bit hard to follow. But if you are good with calculus and math, this course was a breeze and Dhruv covered the topics well. He also taught a few things that were not a part of the syllabus. Passionate teacher.

Dhruv was a lovely guy and an excellent instructor! The material is tough if you're unfamiliar with stats, and he can be a harsh grader at times, but he truly cared about his students and their success. Go to office hours and play Catan with him too!

this class is so easy. just log onto zoom and sit there. the assignments are easy and not worth a lot, the quizzes have unlimited attempts. i don't really like her but that doesn't matter lol

The video final project is a waste of time.

Almost every class had an in-class assignment, an overly complicated (bc it was ill explained) five point activity that sometimes took up to two hours. Her TA/grader took several weeks to grade.

Professor Ard was really disorganized and her class was hard to follow. The assignments were easy, but sometimes lengthy or just straight up annoying. The exams were difficult because her lectures were all over the place, but they're online. Her TA grades everything harshly and not for weeks after assignments are due. Easy A, just an annoying class

Dr. Ard is a great professor; she knows what she's talking about and is passionate about it. The class is easy; there are 3 exams, all online and open-note. She's a great professor, but at the beginning of class during syllabus week, she said that attendance was non-mandatory. It is technically, but not if you want to pass the class. Tests are HEAVILY lecture- and example-based. Go to class, pay attention, and participate and you will do fine. Very nice woman, and interesting lecturer.

Also so final exam

Ashley is a great professor and very caring. The class is very straight forward which is great since it is online. Be prepared to give speeches and get comfortable infront of the camera. She is very accommodating to student needs and very helpful through email. I would definitely take her again!

Super friendly. If you show up, you will pass. Some of the theories are confusing but she comes up with great examples to help explain them more. She also starts out each class with an open ended question, which I found really unique.

Clint was one of the best professors i've had. I love how he talks so much about his background and how he was as a person. Super funny and supper passionate. Overall a great dude and I would take another one of his classes if I could.

Failed quizzes from lectures given by him, and a's on those given by guest lecturers. The lectures make little sense and are supplemented by power points that are little help. Guest lecturers make up probably a little less than half of the classes. No tests, only quizzes and two papers.

The papers can be annoying but he will help you through them. Not hard to get an A, just attend class on TopHat days aka Fridays.

Just Ridiculous, he makes his quizzes and tests based on things that aren't even discussed in the slides or lecture (???????). Everything about him and his class is so unorganized. I don't even know how or why OSU hired him. Just b/c someone has a Ph.D.. it doesn't mean they will be a good professor.

I really don't understand the hate for Ayaz. This obviously isn't the most fun class, but it isn't hard either. Attendance is mandatory, but you pay to go to school here so just show up. He is happy to help with questions but can be a little hard to reach at times. The final isn't bad, there are no "right" answers so just back up your responses.

analysis.name: Aysenur Dal
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 4 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Seems like a difficult class at first, but she explains it very well. Although I asked many questions about the assignment, she responded with patience. She is very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the subject. Additionally, she made use of real life examples based on her political science background which was very interesting.

She is a nice lady but EXTREMELY tough grader. She is a grad student so you would think she would understand the struggle. But no. You do A LOT of papers, and still have two midterms. She's very particular about what she wants and to get an A you have to learn the way she likes things (papers, projects), and do it that way.

She did a really good job making the lackluster content of the slides easy to manage. The class ends with everybody giving a presentation and writing an 8-page paper, but she made it easy to tailor those projects to cater to our interests which made the whole process way more enjoyable.

Very nice and helpful. She is not an easy grader but papers and projects are easy to understand. All in all, she is an easy and helpful professor. As an international student, I receive too much support which I have not received in other classes.

analysis.name: Zeynep Aydogdu
analysis.verdict: Well liked with reasonable difficulty
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 5 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Professor Aydogdu has been one for my favorite college professors thus far. She clearly lays out what the class will be like and what you need to do to get an A, which turns out to be not much. The class is really interesting and actually changed my perspective on how I view the world. I'm so glad I took this class and  I recommend it to everyone!

I absolutely adored having her as a teacher. She is clearly passionate about what she teaches, which makes the class that much more interesting. We read a total of 6 novels for her class, and each one was interesting and thought-provoking. You're graded on participation and in-class discussion, and she encourages you to think for  yourself.

I took this course for a GE credit and to balance out my challenging, upper division, courses for my major. Unfortunately, I made a huge mistake. This course was alot of reading for a GE 2000 level course. She would assign a new book every week. She was a strict grader took pts off for things that were not in her instructions/prompts.

Zeynep is a great professor and is extremely knowledgable, kind, and respected. The class though, is not recommended for anyone who has pride in America. It had an anti-American sentiment and most assigned texts are biased towards how America is viewed. This is not Zeynep's fault, but should be warned before taking the class!

Zeynep was truly one of the best professors I've had thus far at this university. Not only did she provide lessons that showed how much thought and time she put into creating it, but she established a constructive environment that fostered really strong discussion.

analysis.name: Ayten Bayram
analysis.verdict: Well liked with reasonable difficulty, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 12 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: Wonderful class! She is extremely intelligent, but she explains everything until class understands. Notecard allowed for exams, no surprises on exams. One of the best professors I've had, if not the best! Awesome discussions during class, encourages you to think for yourself. If you get the chance, DEFINITELY take a course with her :)

She is seriously AMAZING. She gives you all of the information that you need during her lectures and offers extra credit assignments. Attendance is mandatory and as long as you take some notes, you will definitely get an A. Her powerpoints don't give the information so you have to go to class. But she is so nice and a great teacher!

The first thing I have to say about Ms (hopefully still Ms) Bayram is that she is HOT!! She has a smile that is so tantalizing. As far as the class, it was pretty easy. She allowed us to use a notecard for our tests so hopefully you can write really really small. I walked away with a B but I could've gotten an A. I just got lazy.

She's a very nice and fun teacher. Majority of her tests come from her lectures. She likes to listen to your comments and questions.As long as you go to class and take a few notes then you'll pass. You will need to read the book sometimes. She posts Powerpoint notes online and those are very helpful. Easy class.

Best professor I've ever had! She makes class interesting, and honestly cares what her students have to say. TONS of interesting discussion, so if you get involved it's never boring. Exam was easy, just as long as you go to class and pay attention. She's a genius!!

analysis.name: Tokunbo Ayoola
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 10 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: Dr Ayoola is cool. I like professors from different countries. You might have a hard time with his accent but it's defintitely doable. I took both 121 and 122 and got an A in both. My advice is to take notes from his slides BUT ALSO note down how he elaborates on each slide. This is helpful because you take essay tests and the more info the better.

The person who said Ayoola was rude only said that because HE PRINTED OUT THE PPT and even told us not to write. But the class was an easy A. Both midterm (yes, only one) and final are essays & he gives them to us beforehand. Doesn't grade at all and leaves TAs to handle grades. One pop quiz, but he hinted at it. One of the funniest profs ever.

Dr. Ayoola is RUDE. There were many times when I asked him to return to the page before for notes, and we would argue in front of the class because he didn't want to. Although he was funny, he grew boring as the quarter went by. He tries to make simple assignments more difficult. but he is easy. He isn't useful, the TA's did all of the work.

You will do nothing but scribble off his slides as fast as you can.  He talks during this and expects you to take notes on what he says (which is often unclear) during this.  Boring class.  TA's have too much control of grading.  Gave a 50 point POP (!) comprehensive midterm.  I'm an honors student, and would advise to AVOID AT ALL COSTS

Ayoola is a very good teacher. The last comment is from a lazy, intolerant, opinionated,and arrogant graduating student who did not want to take notes in class; wants an automatic A grade without working for it. He wants to be spoon-fed all the time. Lazy you braggart.

analysis.name: Yaron Azrieli
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 15 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: I thought he actually taught this class pretty clearly.  If you did the homework, you would get full credit for it regardless if you did it wrong.  The only real negative I have for him is that the tests were all multiple choice, and there were usually only 13-17 questions per test.  So not much room for error!

I took this class because I was interested in learning more about micro theory and how different markets worked. Yaron explained things in great detail and he definitely knows his stuff. As long as you try hard to understand everything you'll do fine. And don't get behind in this class because it covers a lot of material fairly quick.

Nice guy and a capable teacher, this class covers a lot of material so go to office hours if you aren't a math whiz. He is very helpful there. Two exam structure was stressful, as the final was half of the grade, though he decided to curve the grade. I'd recommend him.

Yaron is a great professor who teaches the content well. He allows you to prepare one sheet of notes for each exam and there is a slight curve at the end, so take good notes and this class should be pretty easy.

Rather mundane, though there are far worse options for Intermediate micro. Study guides are pretty close to the actual exams, homework is graded on completion. Lectures aren't all that helpful but as long as you do the practice exams and the homework it's doable.

analysis.name: Azita Manouchehri
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 6 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Extremely unprofessional and disrespectful. I don't believe I took anything out of her class. I did not receive thorough feedback on any assignments and when I regularly sought assistance I was repeatedly told that she prefers ambiguity. Expectations were never clear and she refuses to listen to anything you have to say that she disagrees with.

Dr. Manouchehri is overall a great professor. She provides extensive feedback on assignments and is very willing to work with students on her assignments. Her expectations aren't very clear and she has difficulty organizing the assignments for each week. It's clear that she cares about her students and is passionate about education.
Horrible person.  She has quite a high opinion of herself and let me tell you, it is not deserved.  Avoid at all cost!!

Indeed lots of work. Do not take her class if your goal is to reach the minimal requirement of graduation. A good professor who cares about how much you learn instead of how easy it is for you to pass.

analysis.name: Jovica Badjic
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 93 reviews, fairly reliable

review_highlights.comment: Do not take this professor. I honestly would suggest putting this class off a semester if he is your only option. Badjic doesn't care about teaching at all, he walks in class 30 seconds before it starts and runs out the door when its over. Have had a sub 5 classes this semester already. badjic makes this already had class, next to impossible.

Prof Badjic was an okay guy. He has a fun sense of humor but didn't seem to care about teaching. He came in at the last minute and left the second the class ended. The class is difficult enough. He showed example after example but very rarely went into more detail. Thank god for the curve in this class or I would have definitely failed.

Dr. Badjics class wasnt the hardest ochem class at OSU. We got 3 exams and dropped our lowest one and our lowest quiz. But the averages dropped after each exam. His final was pretty tough so be prepared for that. As a person, he seemed distant and intimidating. Even though he was funny in lecture, it was sometimes confusing. Good luck!

He explains concepts in a v simple way that makes a great building block for future hard material. Test/quiz content is directly from the single practice sets he gives so you are set up to get a great grade if you do those until you really understand them. I honestly miss his teaching style and would take him for ochem 2 if I could!

I very much enjoyed Badjic! Out of all of the ochem professors at OSU, he provides 3 midterms, and you can drop your lowest grade. All of the other ochem professor's at OSU only give out 2 midterms and no drops. His quizzes are similiar to his practice sheets. His TA's are very helpful and nice. Personality wise, Badjic is a blunt and chill guy.

analysis.name: Dave Barker
analysis.verdict: Well liked with reasonable difficulty
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 18 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: Graded on 2 exams, a plant collection, and weekly PackBack posts. Very straight forward class. Barker is very personable and funny. I enjoyed taking the class. There is an optional lab (HCS2205) that I suggest taking if you are an HCS or related major but otherwise it is not needed.
Dr. Barker is provides a lot for students but can sometimes go off on tangets. It is easy to zone out in class but the information is all on his webpage.

Dr. Barker's class, though often boring, was made a bit more interesting by his humor and occasional jokes. The class is a good general overview of agriculture, and Dr. Barker was always willing to answer questions and emails. All of his lecture slides (which he just reads in class) are posted online, so going to lecture is pretty much optional.

I took this class online but we did meet with Barker once a week.  I felt that the classtime was useless and did not support the lectures.  If you're not familar with agriculture expect the B range because the exams require a general understanding of Ag. which the lectures don't help with.  Overall an easy A for anyone who is from a farm.

Lecture's are very dry and not interesting. Attendance was not mandatory for lecture. Lab was lead by TA's and were fine, mandatory attendance for lab. If you took the midterm you didn't have to take the final. No one showed up after the midterm. Still an interesting class, professor cares about students and teaching. Just kind of boring

analysis.name: Jonathan  Baker
analysis.verdict: Below average reviews. Worth checking if this fits your learning style, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 57 reviews, fairly reliable

review_highlights.comment: Dr. Baker is hilarious. Hes a very personable guy and homework is very light. Exams are a breeze and he wants his students to get good grades.

Baker never answered emails and would provide important information very late.. or not at all. There was a project worth 20% of my grade and he provided no rubric to complete it. He doesn't keep his TAs in check and slacks on posting homework and exams. Expect to be cold called in class. Easy exams and homework's which makes up for bad lecturing.
He is a good statistics professor. I think he is good at business statistics.
He is a good statistics professor. He is an interesting elder.

Personally, not for me. He was funny and a nice guy, so I have nothing against him personally. As a professor, however, I found him a bit unorganized. He gives a notes outline to fill out; however, I found his slides would often jump around, making it hard to follow. Grading was also left until the last minute.

analysis.name: Joe Barker
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 17 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: Joe Barker is a nice guy and a decent teacher. He tends to get behind in the class schedule because he goes through the slides very slow (sometimes he is too slow and it gets really hard to pay attention and know what is important). The class itself is made up of homework and two exams. The programming assignments can be challenging and take time.

Similar to the previous comment, he's kind of odd. He gives the vibe of a Discord moderator. His lectures are very dry, and he reads right off the slides. He's strangely defensive when questions are asked, but at least his exams are fair and easy if you read the slides.

Huge ego but maybe the weirdest professor I've ever had. He gets offended when students ask questions so we just stopped asking. During review I asked "could you also go over xxx" and he replied "You mean 'would' I also go over that. Obviously I can." Like man I was just being polite obviously I know you can.

Professor Barker is a pretty great professor. While his lectures are a little dry, they're very informative and leave you well-versed in the material. His exams are very fair and the TAs give good feedback on the HWs so that you are able to improve.

Best professor I seen in OSU. he is willing to provide inner depth concept about the lecture instead of read off. It helps you understand the idea instead of memorize things. Homework is easy if you follow along the lecture. lecture gives you pseudocode of homework which make thing super easy. Exam reasonable and easy (avg of 80 in my class).

analysis.name: Benjamin Bohrer
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 10 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: Professor Bohrer is kind and helpful, but it was difficult to figure out the most important topics to study from his lectures. Plus there is a lot of material. Recommend reading the textbook and reviewing the notes before the weekly quizzes.

Bohrer is knowledgeable and cares about students. If you meet with him outside of class he will provide you with the specific topics to study. I have had him for more than one course and most of his courses are structured around detailed slide decks.
He is mainly a read from the slides type of lecturer, but if you understand what is on his slides, you will do well in his class.  I've taken two classes with him and enjoyed him each time!
I have Dr. Bohrer this semester for Animal Phys. The exams are fair and reflective of what the lectures cover. Dr. Bohrer seems caring and wants to see students be successful.
This course is lecture-heavy and the lectures are a bit dry. The slides are very detailed but if you study the slides you should do fine.

analysis.name: Becky Mansfield
analysis.verdict: Well liked with reasonable difficulty, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 24 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: This class covers a lot of complex, but interesting topics. It can definitely be difficult to those not familiar to the material, but do your best with reading all of the articles and showing up and you'll be fine. She's not strict on attendance but showing up really helps you get started writing your papers. She wants to see you engage w/the work.

Dr. Mansfield did not provide an effective background understanding of political ecology. She did not provide her students with a foundation for learning and succeeding in this class. I am an excellent writer, student, and critical thinker, and I struggled in this GE class because the concepts were ill-defined and made no sense. Avoid this class.

Very kind and caring. Assignments are easy to understand and graded leniently. Explanations of topics in class aren't the clearest and the online notes don't help, but you'll still understand the basics.

Becky is a passionate instructor, but as mentioned earlier, achieving a perfect score on assignments is impossible. She sticks with a single grade and applies it consistently throughout the semester. The material is engaging, and it's a relief not to have quizzes or tests, but her tough grading compensates for the absence of exams.

She is a very kind lady and a good professor, however her grading on quizzes is horrible. Very picky on responses no matter what the question is asking. One question asked about your thought on a topic and she only have half a point cause she didn't think the response was thoughtful enough.

analysis.name: Sarah Ball
analysis.verdict: Below average reviews. Worth checking if this fits your learning style, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 198 reviews, this is a reliable picture

review_highlights.comment: In Dr. Ball's offense, I've always hated biology, however, she made me hate it more. Her powerpoints and notes are over topics equivalent to addition, and her tests are derivatives. Lectures are incredibly boring. I would never recommend her to anyone ever. Also not very nice or willing to help. Disappointed.

Despite getting a good grade in this class, I really didn't enjoy it. Her exams are worded in the strangest way, making them much more confusing than they should be. I would only take her if there was no other professor available honestly. One good thing is that she posts her lectures and videos online, so if you miss class, they're available.

I wasn't the biggest fan of Dr. Ball's tests. The information covered in lecture seemed elementary compared to the topics tested. Tophat will boost your grade, so go to class. Her lectures are mildly entertaining. Read the book and don't cram for her exams and you'll be fine.

Dr. Ball was a pretty good teacher overall. Tests were not too bad as long as you had a really good grasp on all the material. Most test questions were application ?'s. You'll definitely need to read the book!!! Also, google Easy Notecards, click on Campbell Biology and do the notecards for the chapters covered on the test(s)- they help so so much

Really knows her stuff, and is a good teacher. Her lectures were  interesting, but long and took the entire time. Tests were tough, but the test questions are all online on flashcards. If you studied those and the lecture slides the class is very manageable.

analysis.name: Steven Bengal
analysis.verdict: Tough course, but students consistently rate the teaching highly
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 111 reviews, this is a reliable picture

review_highlights.comment: If I could have Dr. Bengal teach every psych class I took here, I would. He is knowledgeable, funny, personable, and great professor. There are 3 exams, extra credit for making a cheat sheet for the exams, weekly assignments, occasional Tophat "attendance" checks, and overall wasn't stressful. The material is SO interesting and Dr. Bengal is great

My 2nd class I took with him. Class was ok, I loved him as a professor but the class was not my favorite compared to psych 3375. You have 2 weekly assignments, 3 exams, and random tophat questions. You do get a cheat sheet for each exam which is extra credit. But he didn't round my 89.94 up so now I hate him

Although his class may seem enticing with his visually appealing slides and his comedic lecturing style, save yourself the stress and find another class. If you don't show up to every class and take detailed notes, forget about getting a good grade. His slides are hard to follow and he doesn't list any study guides or review content for exams.

Dr. Bengal was a very engaging professor, but it can be difficult to get an A if extra work isn't put in the study outside of class. The lecture slides were slightly confusing, and there were no notes to accompany them. Don't go to class, then you won't get the information. Three non-cumulative exams and a few different types of assignments.

He gives great lectures, it is easy to follow along without taking notes. He gives 3 exams that are based solely on what is covered in the lecture slides (Available online) and you get a cheat sheet for the exam. I learned more from this class than any other one cause I was never stressing about it.

analysis.name: Bruce Bellner
analysis.verdict: Well liked with reasonable difficulty
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 139 reviews, this is a reliable picture

review_highlights.comment: Bruce Bellner's class was fairly straightforward. If you watch the lecture videos, you should get at least an A- in the class. There was a textbook, but you do not need to read it. The lectures cover everything you need. I would say, however, the exams are quite difficult, but if you study adequately, you should do pretty well. Would recommend

Such an unfair class, especially considering its a 2000 level course, only 1.5 credit hours, and required for every business student. I attended every single lecture at 8 am btw, did every assignment, and spent hours studying for the exam using his slides and recordings, the study plan feature on Pearson and it didn't matter at all for the exam.
Such a non memorable class. It didn't even feel like I took international business when I finished the course. Super hard to study for the exams unless u want to read the textboo

Super difficult to study for exams and you can easily get a bad grade in the class if you do not get a 70% plus on the two exams since those are the only things that change your grade. Bellner is alright, but does not provide any resources to study for exams, and his slideshows during lecture are nothing related to the exam. Very underwhelming

Seems like a nice guy, but he didn't really do it for me. He weights grades, gives no help or study guides for exams, and the exams are unfair and cheap most of the time. He seems to really want you to fail since you will not do well if you don't do well on both of the exams.

analysis.name: Benedetta Leuner
analysis.verdict: Well liked with reasonable difficulty, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 19 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: Extremely bright professor, very knowledgable, and always willing to go above and beyond to help students understand the material. Would take another class with Dr. Leuner in a heartbeat.

Dr. Leuner is a sweet, engaging professor. Her lectures are in line with some of the research she's done and she comes across as super knowledgeable and genuine. Tests are fair, the assignments are mostly for completion and are often interesting. As an aside, she has fantastic style and is quiet gorgeous making it easy to have a crush on her.

She's one of the best professors I've ever had, very straightforward and responds quickly. Not a super tough grader on assignments. I think she explains concepts really well as well. The exams are sometimes pretty hard but if you study and go over the material on the study guide, you should be good! The overall class was interesting too.

This was one of my favorite classes of the semester. Yes, she does read from the slides at times, but she often elaborates and gives further details if people ask questions. It's an interesting subject and she teaches it well. There are optional extra credit assignments throughout the semester, and exams come from the lectures, which are recorded.

This class isn't bad at all if your a neuro major. There are three midterms, one of which you can skip, and a final, as well as a small paper. She posts all lectures online, so I never went unless it was a test day. One thing I thought was off about her is that she's weird about questions. Might as well not even ask because she isn't gonna know.

analysis.name: BD Patel
analysis.verdict: Well liked with reasonable difficulty, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 5 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Professor BD is the coolest, flyest, most easy-going professor ever. He presents a lot of hands on demonstrations like showing us how to properly fall asleep wherever after a night of going out. He also showed us how to properly apply pomade to a faded comb over. Furthermore, Professor BD took us on a class field trip to Ugly Tuna. HES SO COOL!!!!

Relates course material with current events. He has me sipping on Dom Perignon for no reason just like my favorite musician Future. He even taught me how to do the Dab dance move the proper way so it doesnt look like I am checking to see if I put deodorant on. HINT: For extra credit bring autographed Braxton Miller items to class.

Must take class! Professor BD really knows what he's talking about and truly cares about his students. Exams are pretty fair and very similar to the practice ones on Carmen. Book isn't required, although might want to buy the Dom in bulk to save some money. BE PREPARED for the final. Will leave you exhausted the next day.

He was practically drunk every class. So class was great you never had to do anything. Pretty sure he grades the Exams when he is getting bottle service at the bars. So he gives everyone an A. So don't feel so special if you pass. Helpfulness was poor due to the fact that he was never sober.
Words can not describe how amazing this class is, I look at life a completely different way!

analysis.name: Bhavik Bakshi
analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 14 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: Tends to make things overly mathematical which in this class disguises the potential real world value of the course. Didn't seem overly concerned about teaching, sometimes seemed unprepared.
Bakshi was the worst professor I have had in the field of engineering since I started at OSU in Fall of 04. He is unclear and makes easy concepts difficult.

The group project is terrible and requires you to work with unmotivated teammates on a project that should be assigned to a full-time engineer. The tests are almost nothing like the homework and there is no other study material provided. Don't take this class.

The lectures are very conceptual and then you go to do the self-graded homework and they are in depth calculations, most weeks requiring the assistance of office hours. There is also a vague group project in which you are randomly assigned. Also, he calls you out in front of the class if you glance at your phone or laptop during lecture so beware.

This class was my favorite class I've ever taken in CBE, even with it being remote. Dr.B was engaging and cared about the students. He cared the course was valuable. If you put in the effort, the class is not difficult compared to others. His lectures were interesting and all aspects of the class were well organized besides a few technical diff.

analysis.name: Suparna Bhaskaran
analysis.verdict: Most students had a tough time. Look into alternatives if you can
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 9 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: She was a very tough grader and never really told you what she wanted in a paper or how to improve your work. I was sick during the semester and had an excuse and she still failed me for two major although I did them, making my grade drop for the rest of the semester and I was unable to fix it in time. She never answered her email either.

Raised A cutoff to a 95, and never gave a paper grade over a 96 to anyone. Took off points without providing a reason, even when meeting privately. We read entire books in a week, expected to write 100 word max discussion posts and 300-500 word max essays with an unreasonable expectation of detail. Take a class with a normal grade scale.

The cutoff for an A is a 95 in this HONORS class. I do not recommend you take this class, unless you want to spend all your free time reading books and writing papers. Expect low grades and little to no feedback. Suparna i does not provide enough flexibility in extensions for medical conditions, which is absolutely ridiculous considering COVID-19.

This professor I have no words. She expected us to read like a whole book every single week and then write a 300 word essay on the whole book that needed detail and everything. I never got above a 90 on any of my essays and this was just not fair. There was never a steady rubric so I never knew why I missed points. Never take this class for a GE.

The professor has no soul. Despite suffering from many physical and mental ailments during this fully-online course, I was still expected to meet all deadlines with little to no flexibility. This class was so depressing, and it honestly made me want to drop out of college. She does not care about her students; do not take this class ever.

analysis.name: Bhawesh Mishra
analysis.verdict: Good teaching but expect to put in the work, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 3 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Mishra is that one college professor that is a close friend to you, makes you laugh in the class and makes sure that your doubts are cleared. He is hilarious and makes class very interactive and easy to understand. Explains everything in simple words and if you point out his mistake he will give a reaction that will surprise you.

Instructor Mishra is new to teaching. I learned more from him than the actual professor. If you need to take Calculus he is the one. The class is tough, but he breaks it down in a way that one will understand.
Even though the class was a total goof, he still really wanted to help us learn and understand the material.

Good Professor, when he comes to class :)
Loves teaching. Is very knowledgable

analysis.name: V Bhatt
analysis.verdict: Well liked with reasonable difficulty
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 4 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt
